name: io.github.aryanduntley/pwa-debug-layer
title: PWA Debug Layer
description: AI-native MCP debug layer for PWAs: inspect live service workers, CacheStorage, IndexedDB, installability, and React/Vue/Svelte/Solid + Redux/Zustand/Pinia/Jotai state in your real logged-in browser profile. Answers why a service worker won't update, why a cache is stale, why a PWA won't install, and why chunks 404 after a deploy. Complements chrome-devtools-mcp.
